**Niche:** 180 Healthcare Systems (Medicine_Healthcare)  
**Channel Language:** English (YouTube)

## 1. Channel Progression Strategy

This curriculum organizes the core disciplines of Healthcare Systems across four progressive tiers:
- **Tier 1: The Four Models of Healthcare (Beveridge, Bismarck, National Health Insurance, Out-of-Pocket) (Beginner / Scratch)** — T.R. - **Tier 3: Health Equity Disparities, Rural Hospital Deserts & Defensive Medicine Malpractice Dynamics (Upper Intermediate)** — Medical bankruptcy prevalence in uninsured/underinsured populations, closure of rural critical access hospitals, defensive medicine ordering redundant diagnostics, and administrative overhead comparison (8% in Canada vs 25% in US).
- **Tier 4: Value-Based Healthcare Transformation, AI Diagnostic Integration & Pandemic Preparedness Grids (Advanced / Masterclass)** — Accountable Care Organizations (ACOs) transitioning from fee-for-service to value-based care, AI diagnostic triage radiology integration, universal electronic health record interoperability, and designing resilient sovereign emergency health stockpiles.
